text: Wata a ndaaru faade e ko Men waɗani kon nooneeji ɓee fennuɓe dakamme hiɓe dakmitora mo immorde e cuɗaari ngurndan aduna fii yo Men ndarndo ɓe, anndu pellet, koo ko Men waɗaniɓe ɗum ko iwayɗum, Mbarjaari Joomi maa ndi O Fodumaa ndin a heɓay haaweltoɗaa ko ndin ɓuri moƴƴude diini ko Men dakmiti ɓe kon ka aduna immorde dakkamme iwoowo e ɓuroowo duumaade; sabu kanko o taƴataa.
